display_long_description:
Enter the world of Angry Neighbor: Sneak & Survive, a thrilling VR stealth adventure where you must sneak into your neighbor's house, complete missions, and escape without getting caught. Your angry neighbor is always watching, so every move needs careful planning.

Explore the house, discover hidden areas, solve puzzles, and complete challenging tasks while staying out of sight. Use your stealth skills to avoid detection, hide at the right moment, and find the perfect way to complete your objectives. But be careful! If your neighbor spots you, the chase begins, and you must run for survival.

FEATURES:
• Sneak into your angry neighbor's house
• Complete secret missions and tricky tasks
• Use stealth skills to avoid getting caught
• Explore rooms and discover hidden secrets
• Solve puzzles and find the best escape route
• Experience exciting chase moments

Can you complete every mission and escape safely? Step inside, stay quiet, and begin your ultimate neighbor adventure in VR! Plan your moves carefully and stay alert as you explore a challenging environment. Every mission requires patience, timing, and smart decisions. Sneaking past your neighbor will not be easy because he reacts quickly and tries to stop you from completing your goals.

Enjoy interactive VR gameplay with creative challenges and a unique hide-and-seek experience. Search for clues, complete objectives, and escape at the perfect moment while testing your sneaking abilities. Every room hides new challenges.
